category_name: When breaking fast in someone's home
title: When breaking fast in someone's home - Hisn al-Muslim 184
arabic: أَفْطَـرَ عِنْدَكُم الصّـائِمونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعامَـكُمُ الأبْـرار، وَصَلَّـتْ عَلَـيْكُمُ الملائِكَـة
transliteration: Afṭara \`indakumuṣ-ṣā'imūn, wa akala ṭa\'āmakumu 'l-'abrār, wa ṣallat \`alaykumu 'l-malā'ikah.
reference: Abu Dawud 3/367, Ibn Majah 1/556, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah 296-8. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/730.
